💡 Dual-site V/F engineering in NFPP cathodes is novel: F widens Na⁺ channels and stabilizes the CEI, while V³⁺ rigidifies the lattice and cuts the bandgap from 1.138 to 0.179 eV. This concurrently boosts ionic kinetics, electronic conductivity, and interfacial robustness, yielding 93.9% retention over 2000 cycles and providing design principles for durable fast-charging polyanion cathodes.

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Ethyl maltol is introduced as a weakly coordinating small-molecule additive that simultaneously regulates Zn2+ solvation, promotes interfacial desolvation, and passivates defect sites—a triply synergistic approach. This enables dendrite-free deposition and suppressed hydrogen evolution/corrosion, yielding 3500 h symmetric-cell cycling and 5000-cycle full-cell stability, offering a rational molecular-design strategy for multifunctional aqueous zinc-battery electrolytes.

💡 The novelty lies in synthesizing spatially separated Fe-N4 and Co-N4 single-atom sites on g-C3N4 via ball-milling and pyrolysis, where Co-N4 acts as an electronic modulator of Fe active sites. This synergistic interplay optimizes LiO2 intermediate adsorption, enhancing oxygen reduction/evolution kinetics. Significance: the approach delivers improved discharge capacity, lower overpotential, and prolonged cycling stability in Li-O2 batteries, advancing active-site engineering for bi-metal SACs.

item.title: Structural and Electronic Origins Enabling Chlorine Anion Redox in Halide Cathodes
item.description:
با تحلیل ساختاری و شواهد الکترونیکی محاسباتی روی Li2FeCl4 نشان داده شد که ردکس آنیون کلر امکان‌پذیر است و جفت‌شدگی کاهشی Fe-Cl مکانیزم جبران بار را توضیح می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work is the first to demonstrate chlorine anion redox in chloride cathodes, extending anion redox beyond chalcogens. item.title: Stabilizing Oxygen Redox in Polycrystalline Li‐Rich Layered Cathodes via Efficient Grain Boundary Passivation
item.description:
این مقاله با پسیواسیون مرز دانه‌ها به‌وسیله فاز پروسکایتی BaMO3-δ، ردکس اکسیژن را در کاتدهای لایه‌ای غنی از لیتیوم تثبیت می‌کند.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a tannic acid-assisted in situ formation of a BaMO₃₋δ perovskite phase that passivates both surfaces and grain boundaries of polycrystalline Li-rich cathodes. This suppresses oxygen release, improves oxygen-redox reversibility, and mitigates voltage decay. Significance: a scalable, earth-abundant coating method enabling stable high-energy-density cathodes for lithium-ion batteries.
🏷 Li-rich cathode · oxygen redox · grain boundary passivation · perovskite coating · voltage decay
